about: 0069 UI GPU regression cases, DRAFT for root review; nothing has run. Seven existing historical tests (every #[ignore = "requires a native GPU ..."] UI test of the two sources at historical_base, main196) plus one newly added coverage case, label_halo_separates_text_from_bright_and_dark_backdrops, which this packet adds for the prepared halo and which is not a historical test. Each case runs once through regression.py. Frame counts were derived by reading the pinned source: one frame per rendered target or presented host step, counting every world draw and UI submission of a target separately and assuming every Game construction presents one frame, so they over-count rather than under-count. regression.py refuses if either source differs from its SHA-256 here. The frames are tiny (at most 320 physical pixels on a side) and all of them, the new coverage included, are debited from the separate 128-frame regression ceiling, never from the 24 appearance frames.

cases.derivation: one run() per (scale, format): 1x, 2x, 1.5x sRGB and 1x UNORM, at most 320x180
frame(None) draws the world once; frame(Some) draws the world and submits the UI: three submissions to two 160x90 targets
six run() calls (first, again, focus, kept, fresh at 160x90, fresh at 320x180); the two refused stages draw nothing
two Game constructions (counted as one frame each), four loop steps ticking both games (8), then Tab down/up, Enter down/up, focus, commit and preedit ticks (7), at 320x192
one Game construction (counted as one frame), a Tab tick, and two refresh_host presentations (320x192, then 240x320); resize_ui admits without presenting and the malformed resize is refused
